title: Sleep Study Coverage
extracted_text:
Example Health Plan
Sleep Study Coverage Policy SS002

Initial Criteria
1. The member must meet ALL of the following:
   a. The member is 18 or older.
   b. ONE of the following symptoms is documented:
      i. Loud snoring reported by a bed partner.
      ii. Witnessed pauses in breathing during sleep.
      iii. Daytime sleepiness score of 10 or higher.
   c. No in-lab sleep study in the last 12 months.
